summary: Expose explicit selected-use activity for controlled raw terminal observations

rules.detail: RULES_VERSION remains11; no checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Client controlled streams expose an activity handle for explicit foreground-selected renewal. Byte-only streams remain idle-expiring; successful control send is not renewal acknowledgement.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption beyond a normal daemon upgrade.

manual.detail: Update consumers to renew only foreground-selected observations and stop controls on deselection/backgrounding. Rotate/reacquire with fresh readiness at expiry or EOF.

recovery.detail: No data rewrite or destructive migration; existing binary swap-back behavior is unchanged. Older builds retain their older observation enforcement.
